caption:
Aging: It’s your face or your ass 

#shereeneidriss #aging #aginggracefully
on_screen_hook: People that have fat in their face age the best. It's the
transcript: People that have fat in their face age the best. It's the truth. And this, it's. It's something that I personally never wanted to agree with until I saw it. Which is why, as you get older, it's always been your face or your ass. Because for years, everyone has been so obsessed with looking so snatched. Sharper cheekbones, hollow cheek, um, buckle fat removal. Now it seems like the internet is finally catching up, and I've been a cosmetic dermatologist for over a decade, and the wrinkle part of aging is only a tiny part of the aging story, because underneath the skin, there is an entire support system that is actively changing. Your facial fat pad compartments are shrinking and shifting, your bones are gradually getting hollower, and the scaffolding that once held up your face to full fullness is changing shape and melting. So suddenly, your cheeks look flatter, your temples look hollower, and your eyes look more sunken in. And here's the irony. The very fat that you have spent years trying to get rid of is the one thing that is keeping you looking youthful. Which is exactly why I have been so vocal and against unnecessary buckle fat removal. You're permanently removing this gold from your cheeks to create a hollow look that aging is gonna give you for free. Now we are even seeing younger people consider faceless before they've even ever started aging. And this is the thing I think most people Do not understand. Lifting your face and restoring volume are two very different things. And just because you can make a face look more lifted or sculpted with a facelift, it doesn't necessarily mean you're gonna make it look younger or healthier. Number one, be mindful of unnecessary or very rapid weight loss, because facial volume is gonna go with your ASS2. Before you permanently remove fat from your face, I want you to ask yourself, am I getting rid of something that I genuinely do not want, or is this something that I might spend the next 20 years trying to get back? And last, the goal is not to chase whatever face is trending today. It is to take care of your face today so that you could be living with it 20 years from now.

caption:
Milia also referred to as “milk spots” are small, pearly white cysts that typically appear on the face around the lower eyelids, forehead, or cheeks. Milia occurs when dead skin cells and natural oils become trapped in the skin’s pores. 

There are many causes of milia which include: 
- Improper skin exfoliation can lead to buildup of keratin that can lead to milia
- Cosmetic products such as concealers, foundations, moisturizers that don’t suit your skin type
- Genetics
- Excessive sun exposure
on_screen_hook: Hi everyone, it's Doctor Ariel Low stack, cosmetic dermatologist. I wanted to
transcript: Hi everyone, it's Doctor Ariel Low stack, cosmetic dermatologist. I wanted to just briefly talk to you about something that I commonly see during the course of the weekend. That is a condition where people present with what we call Milia Amelia are these white, little tiny whitehead bumps that occur on the face. I've seen them on the forehead, cheeks, nose, chin, sermia, even close to the eyelids. And the common cause for this condition is the skin care products that we put on our face. These are can be moisturizers, concealers, foundation, sunscreen. It doesn't mean that that product is not a good product or the ingredients in it are bad, is just that it's not the right fit for your skin type. A lot of people can use those products and not have an issue, especially people with dry skin. But people with normal to oily skin can unfortunately get blocked pores as a result of using these products. So these products basically block your pores, and as a result, these keratin bumps develop under the skin. And the treatment for them is to really just extract them in the office, which is quite simple and easy to do. So it's important that if you see those things, to change your skincare routine and use something different.
